text:
mara: quick flag 1: the Go quickstart in docs/quickstart-go.md has an env var mismatch and a dated import. New users hitting auth fails.

ton y: what is the mismatch?

mara: README shows REDWOOD_API_KEY but the SDK now expects REDWOOD_TOKEN. also import path `github.com/redwood-inference/sdk-go/v1` should be `github.com/redwood/redwood-go`.

ton y: thanks. can you paste the broken snippet?

mara: broken: `client := sdk.NewClient(os.Getenv("REDWOOD_API_KEY"))` and `import "github.com/redwood-inference/sdk-go/v1"`

ton y: propose changing to `token := os.Getenv("REDWOOD_TOKEN")` and `redwood.NewClient(redwood.WithToken(token))`, plus update import. please add a short migration note too.

sdk-ci: opened PR #501 to update quickstart-go.md. snippet-checker will run on merge.

docs-bot: PR #501 merged. added changelog entry and a one-line deprecation note for REDWOOD_API_KEY in the v1 upgrade guide.

ton y: I'll follow up to add a tiny CI job to execute Go snippets in docs so we catch these automatically.

mara: perfect, thanks everyone :)
